data_policy.content_storage: factual game discovery metadata and short assistant-generated Chinese summaries
data_policy.rights_note: Source images remain owned by their respective rights holders. Downloading and public visibility do not establish a redistribution license. No full descriptions, videos, game code or other game assets stored.

collection_status_note: Five homepage entries and linked details observed. Four details succeeded; Subway Surfers rendered 404. Four real cover downloads were decoded and hashed, but HTTP status/header verification is unavailable, so all four cover repository paths remain null and are not claimed as published assets.

scope.sampling_rule: Up to the first 10 games in the visible homepage 热门免费游戏 numbered list; the rendered list contains only five, all retained. Inspect the first five distinct linked details. No filler entries added.
scope.section_definition_raw: 根据实时游玩热度统计，这些是 Poki 上目前最热门的 5 大当红游戏 。
scope.position_semantics: Explicit numbered homepage position, source-claimed real-time play popularity with no disclosed formula. Not independently verified global rank or interchangeable with detail rank.

source_extensions.detail_navigation_note: Cloud browser only. Five linked details inspected after scheduled time. No gameplay input, votes, login, hidden APIs or user computer. Initial detail-cover download attempts timed out; direct navigation to observed currentSrc image URLs allowed four successful downloads. HTTP response status and headers are not exposed by the documented API.

limitations: Bounded nonrandom public UI sample, not a complete catalog or independently verified popularity score.
Only the homepage 热门免费游戏 numbered list was sampled. It has five entries; no unrelated games were added to fill ten.
Homepage numbering and detail popularity ranks are separate source displays and may disagree.
K/M values are rounded source abbreviations. Votes are not plays, unique users, or concurrency.
Level Devil shows 在线 5,000+ only in the later current-run read; saved as a lower bound >=5000 with unspecified online definition and time window, not exact CCU.
Level Devil release metadata changed within this run from 2023年12月 to 2023年11月. Both exact source observations are preserved; no real release-date change inferred.
Other inspected details show no numeric online display; absent values stay null and no previous metric is copied.
Subway Surfers title is 404未找到结果 and visible page says it does not exist. HTTP status is not exposed; this does not establish permanent delisting.

Four thumbnails were downloaded as PNG bytes, decoded at 314x314, SHA-256 verified and visually inspected. HTTP status/content-type headers remain unverified. Their cover status is verification_incomplete; repository_path, sha256 and fetched_at_utc are null in the cover main object. Candidate-byte validation is separate and is not a repository asset claim.
The four candidate hashes match existing repository PNG assets, but the existing assets do not remedy this run’s missing HTTP verification and are not claimed as validated reuse.
Detail frames may auto-load; no gameplay interaction occurred. Short-interval differences may reflect hydration/cache/display changes and do not establish growth.

Drive Mad body copy separately attributes over 300 million plays since 2019 to Fancade. This historical third-party claim has uncertain platform scope and is not used as the current Poki plays metric.
